sections.heading: Our Story
paragraphs: AAPNA Infotech is a leading provider of software development solutions. We specialize in line-of-business application development which helps our customers in lowering total cost of ownership (TCO). Since we have focused on a few specific technologies, our team has established significant expertise in their domains. We pride ourselves on our ability to deliver scalable, robust, and highly flexible solutions to clients across the globe with increased ROI by improving business efficiency.

Our environment fosters the individual growth of all of our employees, and we are proud to help transform our people into the future leaders of the software industry. We feature a highly experienced team of managers and diverse creative and technical teams who strongly believe in providing the utmost quality to all our clients. Our teams provide a one-stop source for all of your technology needs from: Software strategy, business intelligence, system architecture and design, implementation, integration, and support.
